about.title: About BMI Calculator
about.description: The BMI Calculator determines your Body Mass Index for health assessment and weight management. This professional tool calculates BMI based on height and weight measurements to categorize weight status and assess potential health risks. BMI is a widely used screening tool for underweight, normal weight, overweight, and obesity classifications. Understanding your BMI helps make informed decisions about diet, exercise, and lifestyle changes for optimal health and wellness.

faq.q: What is a healthy BMI range for adults?
faq.a: A healthy BMI typically ranges from 18.5 to 24.9 according to WHO standards. BMI below 18.5 is considered underweight, 25-29.9 is overweight, and 30+ is classified as obese. Our BMI calculator provides these classifications automatically with your results.

faq.q: Is BMI calculation accurate for everyone?
faq.a: BMI has limitations and may not be accurate for athletes with high muscle mass, elderly individuals, pregnant women, or certain ethnic groups. It's best used as a general health screening tool alongside other assessments like body fat percentage and waist circumference.

faq.q: How do I calculate my BMI manually?
faq.a: BMI is calculated using the formula: weight (kg) ÷ height (m)². For imperial units: (weight in pounds ÷ height in inches²) × 703. Our BMI calculator automates this process and provides instant results with health recommendations.

faq.q: How often should I check my BMI for health monitoring?
faq.a: For general health monitoring, checking BMI monthly or quarterly is sufficient. If you're actively trying to lose or gain weight, weekly BMI measurements can help track progress alongside other health metrics.

faq.q: What should I do if my BMI is outside the healthy range?
faq.a: If your BMI is outside the healthy range (18.5-24.9), consult with a healthcare professional for personalized advice. They can assess your overall health, body composition, and recommend appropriate diet, exercise, and lifestyle modifications.

faq.q: Can BMI be used for children and teenagers?
faq.a: BMI for children and teenagers is calculated differently using age and sex-specific percentiles rather than adult categories. Our calculator is designed for adults 18+. Consult a pediatrician for child BMI assessments.
